title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
Passionate about product innovation and exceptional user experiences? Join us to shape the future of our Word Press products! Be part of a dynamic team driving exciting changes. Responsibilities Product Vision and Strategy: Define the overarching vision and strategic goals for our product portfolio. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and gather customer feedback. Identify opportunities for product differentiation and innovation. Roadmap Planning and Prioritization: Develop product roadmap, prioritize features based on business objectives and customer needs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment (development, support and marketing) Product Mockups: Work closely with the team to plan product features and create mockups. Ensure that product designs align with user needs and business objectives. Feature Definition: Work closely with the team to define user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specifications. Prioritize features based on their impact on users, revenue and market competitiveness. Feature Acceptance: Conduct final acceptance testing to ensure that features meet quality standards. Provide the final go-ahead for product releases based on acceptance testing results. Ensure adherence to timelines. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication: Engage with stakeholders and align customers satisfaction with business goals. Communicate product vision, roadmap, and progress to internal teams and external stakeholders. Required Skills and

QUALIFICATIONS:
In-depth knowledge of Word Press ecosystem and familiarity with relevant technologies. Understanding of user needs and business objectives Ability to prioritize features based on their impact on user satisfaction and business goals. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategies and plans. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with stakeholders. Experience working in tools like Jira, Linear, etc for backlog management. Proven track record of product planning, acceptance testing, and product design. Your Success: Your success will be measured by following KPIs that reflect the impact of your contributions: Product Growth and Revenue: Market share or penetration of the product compared to competitors. Revenue generated by the product. Percentage growth in product revenue over time. Customer Satisfaction and Retention: Net Promoter Score (NPS) or customer satisfaction survey results. Customer retention rate or churn rate. Customer feedback and sentiment regarding overall product experience. Product Performance and Market Positioning: Market share or competitive positioning of the product. Customer perception of product differentiation and value proposition compared to alternatives. Innovation and Product Roadmap Execution: Rate of new feature delivery or innovation. Percentage of product roadmap milestones achieved on schedule. Adoption rate of new product features or enhancements. Team Collaboration and Alignment: Feedback from cross-functional teams regarding collaboration and alignment with product strategy. Team morale and satisfaction with product direction and leadership. Effectiveness of communication and alignment with stakeholders. Some of our Products: You will contribute to products that are trusted by millions worldwide, making a significant impact. Below are some of our flagship products: Astra: A versatile and lightweight Word Press theme trusted by millions for its speed, flexibility, and customization options. Spectra: A website builder for Word Press based on the Block Editor, empowering users to create stunning websites with ease using blocks and templates. Starter Templates: A collection of professionally designed website templates for various niches, compatible with Word Press and Astra theme. Zip WP: An AI-powered website builder for Word Press, enabling users to create websites quickly and effortlessly through intuitive drag-and-drop functionality. Sure Cart: An e-commerce solution for Word Press, offering a seamless shopping experience with features like product management, checkout customization, and payment gateways. Otto Kit: An automation and integration platform that streamlines workflows by automating repetitive tasks and connecting different software applications seamlessly. Late Point: A modern and intuitive appointment booking system for Word Press, empowering businesses to manage appointments, bookings, and scheduling effortlessly. Sure Members: A membership site solution for Word Press, allowing users to create and manage membership levels, subscriptions, and content access with ease. Cart Flows: A sales funnel builder for Word Press, helping users create high-converting sales funnels with features like one-click upsells, order bumps, and checkout customization. Presto Player: A feature-rich video player plugin for Word Press, offering advanced customization options, video analytics, and seamless integration with popular video hosting platforms. Who are we? We are a team of designers, developers, and marketers. As one of the most successful Word Press product companies globally, we have built an exciting place to work. We’re revolutionizing how people create websites and save money, time, and stress to empower web professionals to make beautiful websites faster than ever. Our talented team creates products that help web professionals improve and simplify their lives. Our diverse group of individuals worldwide ( India, US, UK, Philippines, Indonesia, Serbia, Romania, and more) work with a shared passion for product development and creating an outstanding user experience. Join a team of smart, ambitious driven people who value open communication and processes. 🌍 KPI’s for Success: Increased traffic and conversions from owned channels. Growth in signups, website traffic and product revenue. Improved conversion rates across funnels and campaigns. Number and quality of partnerships, affiliates, and creators engaged. Execution of successful product launches or large campaigns. Improved team velocity and on-time delivery of campaigns. What do we offer you? We believe in working closely and bringing the best out in each other. We’re a fun, supportive, and creative group of individuals. We’ll offer you: Competitive pay. Work from anywhere. The opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-growing team. We don’t micro-manage. Manage your own time as you see fit Flexible work environment – We believe that people work best when they have the freedom to work from wherever they choose. We don’t care where you are so long as you get the work done. Fun atmosphere – let your hair down now and then. Challenging tasks – Equip yourself by tackling new challenges. Limitless ability to grow within the company. Many of our employees have been with us for more than 5 years and continue to grow and learn along with us. Learn something new every day – Grow your career with bright possibilities Fitness Motivators – Join our #Fit Sharks cult to be a part of a journey to boost your fitness. Sounds like a good fit? Want to apply for this position? Just fill in the form on this page. We look forward to hearing from you! title: R&D Specialist — WordPress
jobDescription:
Passionate about problem-solving, detail-oriented, and a Word Press enthusiast? Perfect opportunity to make a significant impact. Join us and be part of our journey today! Responsibilities Research and Analysis: Conduct thorough research on user needs and preferences, staying up-to-date with industry trends and market demands. Analyze competitor products, identify their strengths and weaknesses, and use this knowledge to inform our development process. Discover and document interesting use cases, features, and enhancements based on user feedback and market research. Product Design Collaboration: Work closely with the product design team to brainstorm and contribute to the creation of a beautiful user experience for product. Provide insights and suggestions for improving the visual design, usability, and overall user interface of the plugin. Collaborate with designers to ensure that user requirements and research findings are incorporated into the design process effectively. Development Support: Collaborate with our development team, providing insights and guidance during the development process. Help translate user requirements and research findings into clear specifications and actionable tasks. Assist in troubleshooting technical issues and providing solutions to enhance the overall functionality and user experience. Quality Assurance and Acceptance Testing Participate in the quality assurance process, conducting thorough testing to ensure the product meets high standards of performance, usability, and compatibility. Collaborate closely with the development team to address any issues or bugs that arise during testing. Continuously monitor and evaluate the product’s performance, comparing it with competitor offerings, and provide recommendations for improvements. User-centric Approach: Use your experience in building websites as a freelancer or agency team member to relate to user needs and challenges. Act as a user advocate, testing the product from a user’s perspective and ensuring it meets their requirements and expectations. Leverage insights from user feedback and competitor analysis to drive continuous improvement and innovation within product. User Support: Monitor support channels to identify areas where users need assistance, get confused, or require improvement. Provide timely and effective support to users whenever needed, addressing their queries, troubleshooting issues, and guiding them through the product’s features and functionality. Collaborate with the support team to gather user feedback, identify common pain points, and suggest improvements to enhance the user experience. Marketing Support Participate in the social media and community to engage and support our users. Create visually appealing demos and landing pages to showcase newly developed features and functionality of product. Collaborate with the marketing team to provide input and insights for promotional materials and campaigns related to the product. Help write documentation and effective changelogs to communicate updates and new features to users and stakeholders. Agile Methodologies: Learn and adopt agile methodologies for efficient project management. Write user stories, detailing the functionality from a user’s perspective, to effectively communicate requirements to the development team. Manage and maintain the Jira board, ensuring that user stories, tasks, and bugs are accurately captured and tracked throughout the development lifecycle. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily stand-ups to ensure alignment and progress. You Must Have: Strong understanding of Word Press and experience in working with Word Press page builders and website builders, with particular emphasis on Gutenberg. Experience in conducting user research, competitor analysis, and translating findings into actionable insights for development teams. Solid knowledge of website development processes, including front-end and back-end technologies. Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment. Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks effectively. Excellent communication skills are must, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. As a Word Press Research & Development Specialist, you will play a vital role in shaping the future of our products. Your expertise in user research, development support, quality assurance, user-centric approaches, and agile methodologies will be instrumental in driving the success of our product. We look forward to working with you! Who are we? We are a team of designers, developers, and marketers. As one of the most successful Word Press product companies globally, we have built an exciting place to work. We’re revolutionizing how people create websites and save money, time, and stress and empower web professionals to make beautiful websites faster than ever. Our talented team creates products that help web professionals improve and simplify their lives. Our diverse group of individuals from all over the world ( India, US, UK, Philippines, Indonesia, Serbia, Romania, and more) work with a shared passion for product development and creating an outstanding user experience. Join a team of smart, ambitious, driven people who value open communication and processes. What do we offer you? We believe in working closely and bringing the best out in each other. We’re a fun, supportive, and creative group of individuals. We’ll offer you: Competitive pay. Work from anywhere. The opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-growing team. We don’t micro-manage. Manage your own time as you see fit Flexible work environment – We believe that people work best when they have the freedom to work from wherever they choose. We don’t care where you are so long as you get the work done. Fun atmosphere – let your hair down now and then. Challenging tasks – Equip yourself by tackling new challenges. Limitless ability to grow within the company. Many of our employees have been with us for more than 5 years and continue to grow and learn along with us. Learn something new every day – Grow your career with bright possibilities Fitness Motivators – Join our #Fit Sharks cult to be a part of a journey to boost your fitness. Sounds like a good fit? Want to apply for this position? Just fill in the form on this page. We look forward to hearing from you!
